title: Farmers and Shiv Sena (UBT) protest for drought relief in Washim

tea.why: Protesters called the government's advance drought relief of Rs 5,000 inadequate for farmers facing destroyed Kharif crops.
tea.want: Compensation of Rs 1 lakh per hectare, immediate settlement of crop insurance claims, and remunerative prices for agricultural produce.
tea.changed: Oct 30: Police detained MLA Nitin Deshmukh and several protesters before they reached the Samruddhi Expressway, releasing them later that evening.

summary: On October 30, 2026, hundreds of farmers and members of the Shiv Sena (UBT) party, led by MLA Nitin Deshmukh, marched towards the Vanoja interchange of the Samruddhi Expressway in Maharashtra's Washim district to stage a road blockade. The demonstrators demanded a compensation of Rs 1 lakh per hectare for drought-hit farmers, immediate settlement of crop insurance claims, and better prices for agricultural produce, calling the state government's advance relief of Rs 5,000 insufficient. Authorities had denied permission for the highway protest and deployed approximately 1,500 to 3,000 police personnel, including units from neighboring districts and the State Reserve Police Force. Police stopped the protesters, resulting in minor scuffles, and detained several individuals including MLA Nitin Deshmukh before releasing them later in the day.
demands: Compensation of Rs 1 lakh per hectare for drought-hit farmers
Immediate settlement of pending crop insurance claims
response: Police denied permission for the protest, deployed around 1,500 to 3,000 personnel to secure the expressway, blocked the marchers, and detained MLA Nitin Deshmukh alongside other participants before releasing them at 5 pm.

crowd.text: Over 10,000 farmers from across Vidarbha took part in the protest, according to organizer claims.

arrests.text: Police detained MLA Nitin Deshmukh and several other Shiv Sena (UBT) functionaries before releasing them later.

updates.text: Shiv Sena (UBT) members and farmers marched towards the Samruddhi Expressway in Washim to protest against inadequate drought relief.
Police detained MLA Nitin Deshmukh and several protesters following scuffles near the Vanoja interchange.
Detained protesters and MLA Nitin Deshmukh were released by police at 5 pm.
